name: RSI Levels
summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought and oversold levels, entering buy positions when RSI dips below the oversold threshold and sell positions when RSI rises above the overbought threshold. It aims to capture mean reversion moves as price is expected to return to neutral RSI levels. The EA includes configurable RSI period and level parameters for customization across different instruments and timeframes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖水平进行交易，当RSI跌破超卖阈值时买入，当RSI突破超买阈值时卖出。其核心逻辑是均值回归，预期价格会从极端水平回归中性区域。EA提供可配置的RSI周期和水平参数，适用于不同品种和时间框架。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI指标的均值回归原理，认为当RSI进入超买或超卖区域后，价格有回归均值趋势。入场条件为RSI跌破超卖水平（默认30）时开多单，RSI突破超买水平（默认70）时开空单。出场条件依赖于RSI回到中性区域或达到止盈止损目标。仓位管理通常采用固定手数方式，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA依赖RSI水平参数的合理设置来控制交易频率和风险敞口，但缺乏对市场趋势环境的过滤，可能在强趋势行情中产生连续逆势信号导致亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is rooted in mean reversion using the RSI indicator, assuming that when RSI enters overbought or oversold zones, price tends to revert toward the mean. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI drops below the oversold level (default 30) and a sell when RSI rises above the overbought level (default 70). Exit conditions rely on RSI returning to neutral territory or hitting predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots, though some variants may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management depends on the proper configuration of RSI level thresholds to control trade frequency and exposure, but the strategy lacks a trend environment filter which can result in consecutive counter-trend signals and losses during strong trending markets.

pros: 逻辑简单直观，易于理解和调试
RSI是成熟的技术指标，超买超卖概念有统计学支撑
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间框架优化
均值回归策略在震荡行情中表现良好
入场信号明确，不产生模糊判断
pros_en: Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and debug
RSI is a well-established technical indicator with statistical backing for overbought/oversold concepts
Highly configurable parameters allow optimization across different instruments and timeframes
Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets
Clear entry signals without ambiguous judgment criteria
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤，在强趋势行情中容易连续逆势亏损
固定手数缺乏动态资金管理，无法根据市场波动调整仓位
默认止损止盈为0，存在较大资金安全风险
单一指标策略信号过于简单，缺乏多维度确认
未包含新K线检查机制，可能在一根K线内重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks trend filter, prone to consecutive counter-trend losses in strong trending markets
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic money management, unable to adjust position based on market volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit set to 0, posing significant capital safety risk
Single-indicator strategy is overly simplistic without multi-dimensional confirmation
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions within a single bar
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如MA或ADX），避免在强趋势行情中逆势交易
实现动态仓位管理，基于ATR或账户风险百分比计算手数
添加新K线检查和最大持仓限制，防止重复开仓和过度暴露
加入移动止损和保本止损机制，保护已获利润
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA or ADX) to avoid counter-trend trades in strong trending markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage
Add new bar check and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries and overexposure
Incorporate trailing stop and break-even mechanisms to protect accumulated profits

risk_points: 默认止损为0，存在单笔交易无限亏损风险
缺乏趋势过滤，强趋势行情中可能连续逆势开仓
无新K线检查可能导致同一K线内多次开仓放大风险
单一RSI指标在极端行情中失效概率高
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 0 creates unlimited per-trade loss risk
Lack of trend filter may cause consecutive counter-trend entries in strong trends
No new bar check may lead to multiple entries within a single bar, amplifying risk
Single RSI indicator has high failure probability in extreme market conditions
